hooks.text: 多类近战武器配合蓄力、反击、格挡、闪避、空中与墙面移动，形成高速动作系统。
hooks.excerpt: Master the mechanics of various weapons, including katanas, great katanas, spears, greatswords, chakrams, and more. Standard attacks, charged attacks, precision charged attacks, counters, rising attacks, and other general combat moves. Parry counter, blocking, dodging, perfect dodge, double jump, wall grab, ledge grab, dash glide, and other action elements.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 局内选择塔罗词条并重洗武器强化，局外再用合成血升级科技树。
hooks.excerpt: In each challenge, choose different Tarot card entries to gain enhancement mechanics and corresponding attributes. Reroll weapon enhancement entries in the shop, using limited resources and luck to pursue the maximum damage potential. Consume "Synthetic Blood" to upgrade the out-of-game tech tree, continuously improving the character's basic abilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色和敌人采用手绘像素美术，并强调复杂流畅的动画表现。
hooks.excerpt: Nearly all characters and enemies are hand-drawn in pixel art, with complex and fluid animations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
